The HWPX generation failed because the required severity string 'High (즉시조치)' was missing from the combined XML output of section0.xml and section1.xml.
The verifier failed with an AssertionError in test_overview_values_and_actions_are_present within /tests/test_outputs.py. Specifically, the assertion `assert f'{value} ({severity_map[value]})' in combined` failed because 'High (즉시조치)' was not found in the generated HWPML section XML. While 3 tests passed, the summary values and immediate actions were not correctly mapped into the final document structure.
